name: Highland Hides

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can find tradesmen like James Halloran in Menethil Harbor, a key port in the Wetlands. They equip travelers heading into the dangerous marshlands nearby.
As a Hunter, you can track formidable beasts such as Thicket Raptors in the Highlands’ mountain marshes. Their tough hides call for precise tracking and a clean hunt.

faq.answer: James Halloran is a tanner and craftsman in Menethil Harbor. He works with leather and oils, seeking fine skins from exotic beasts across the Wetlands and surrounding highlands for trim and armor.

aliases: why does james want raptor hides
faq.answer: Halloran wants Thicket Raptor hides for their durability and texture. He uses them to add fine details to leatherwork trim.
faq.q: Why does James Halloran need these hides?

faq.answer: Thicket Raptors live in the mountainous marshlands of the Highlands, near forgotten ruins an expedition is exploring.
faq.q: Where can Thicket Raptors be found?

faq.answer: An expedition team is investigating forgotten ruins in the Highlands. Halloran focuses on the wildlife while scholars and explorers investigate the area’s ancient secrets.
faq.q: What ruins is Halloran referring to?

aliases: do i need friends for highland hides
faq.answer: Halloran recommends traveling with well-equipped companions. Fierce wildlife makes the mountain marshlands dangerous for anyone traveling alone.
faq.q: Is this hunt intended for a group?

faq.answer: Halloran offers leatherwork from his workshop in exchange for four Thicket Raptor hides. Travelers can choose a piece suited to their journeys.
faq.q: What does James Halloran offer in trade?

sections.body: From his workshop in Menethil Harbor, James Halloran seeks rare materials for his craft. Word reaches him of an expedition exploring forgotten ruins in the Highlands. He turns his attention to the beasts roaming the mountain marshes. Their hides suit his work, so he hires travelers to bring back fine pelts from the misty peaks.
sections.title: A Tanner's Opportunity

sections.body: Thicket Raptors prowl the rugged marshes of the Highlands. Their tough, textured skins suit specialized leatherwork. Halloran asks travelers to hunt these predators and return with four intact hides. He uses them for fine details and decorative trim in his workshop’s creations.
sections.title: Beasts of the Highlands

summary: In the Highlands, Thicket Raptors offer tough hides for James Halloran’s leatherwork. The tanner in Menethil Harbor trades crafted goods for their skins.
